label: D1 after repeated unrewarded a2->S2 (common) trials, late episode
explanation: Fires only at D1 (never at GO or D2), when no reward is shown and the previous trial was a2 with a common move to S2. Almost all of its activation mass falls in the second half of the episode (ep_trial >= 50, mostly 60-89) and none before trial 40. It is strongest when the losses come in a row: the trial before was also unrewarded. In the top windows the activation goes from about 0.6 after the first a2/S2 loss to 1.0 after the second. Requiring two losses in a row raised dev F1 from 0.37 to 0.56. When it is active the model value is low (mostly < 7.1) and S1 is usually the hidden good state, so these are the moments when a2 is failing. It does not fire after rewarded trials (3% of mass), after a1 choices, or after rare a2->S1 transitions. Every variable in the predicate is observed. The recall gap comes from window-start D1 steps (rel -3), where the history is cut off, and from weak firings after a single loss. Precision is about 0.5, so many matching steps stay silent, and no extra observed variable sharpened it.
